templates.audience: US gamers 10–17 and their older siblings; watches Roblox horror playthroughs.

patterns: This hiding spot looks safe. Is it?

visual.source: gameplay for evidence; generated only for setup, boards, CTA

music.mood: low drone, ducked under game audio

thumbnail.rules: avatar large, one threat, 2–4 words, blue vs red

title: I Tested {n} Roblox Horror Myths
Is {claim} Actually True in {game}?
compliance: No fake results or secrets
Label AI illustrations
Name the experience and version

globalLock.character: RHM_INVESTIGATOR_01. Use the approved master reference assets/character-reference.png once it exists. Preserve face, block proportions, messy black swept hair with three front tufts, silver-blue three-prong crown, black techwear jacket with white zipper/drawstrings and blue piping, utility straps, black backpack with cyan core, charcoal cargo pants, black-and-white high-tops, cyan lantern. The SVG is a guide, not a reference image.
globalLock.style: Premium collectible Roblox-inspired avatar, cinematic game lighting, crisp silhouettes, cool blue/cyan accents, graphite shadows, occasional amber practicals and restrained red danger light. Mobile-readable. No text inside generated images.
accuracy: Never invent mechanics, updates, player counts, secrets, reactions, outcomes, quotes or footage
Every challenge claim is a hypothesis until recorded gameplay supports it
Name the exact experience and version/update
Gameplay vs AI illustration always distinguished; illustrations are never proof
No false promise in title, thumbnail, narration or CTA
globalLock.retention: Open on a real high-stakes moment or question; promise fast; no greeting or filler; a real change every 20–40s; satisfying ending; no fake cliffhangers; SFX support, never drown gameplay.

list.name: Myth Lab
list.prompt: Test [NUMBER] claims in [EXPERIENCE], version [VERSION], [LENGTH]. Per claim: hypothesis, controlled test, fixed variables, attempts, confirm/contradict criteria, capture list, timecoded segment, narration that does not pre-announce the verdict, replay plan, verdict CONFIRMED / BUSTED / INCONCLUSIVE kept pending until footage review. Output storyboard, experiment register, narration, thumbnails, missing evidence.

list.name: Secret & Easter Egg Hunt
list.prompt: Investigate [SECRET / CLUE] in [EXPERIENCE], [VERSION] as a chain of verifiable clues: real clue → known vs speculation → inspect locations → test each lead → decisive interaction or failure → what footage proves. If unverified, the honest outcome is the story; no "SECRET FOUND" thumbnail.

list.name: One-Life Challenge
list.prompt: [EXPERIENCE]: objective [OBJECTIVE], tools [TOOLS], fail condition [FAIL], attempts [ATTEMPTS]. Rules fixed before recording. Hook → setup → attempts → setbacks → rule reminders → climax → result. Rules card, recording checklist, storyboard, narration beats, thumbnail A/B/C. Outcome open until recorded.

list.name: Survival Guide
list.prompt: Guide for [EXPERIENCE] and [PROBLEM / PUZZLE / MONSTER], each step verified. Obstacle → what you learn → prerequisites → each step → common failures → shortest reliable recap. Callouts, capture list, chapters, version/date caveat. No guaranteed routes without evidence.

list.name: Legend Investigation
list.prompt: Investigate [LEGEND] tied to [EXPERIENCE]. Separate confirmed events, community claims, speculation. Strongest clue → sourced origin → evidence → in-game reproduction → alternative explanations → conclusion with confidence. Atmosphere over fake jump scares; AI scenes labeled.

list.name: Update Breakdown
list.prompt: Explain [UPDATE / DATE] for [EXPERIENCE] from patch notes, footage or cited sources. Biggest confirmed change → overview → each change → who it affects → before/after only with comparable footage → takeaways. Source list and date. Never invent patch notes.

list.name: Tier List
list.prompt: Rank [SUBJECTS] in [EXPERIENCE] by stated [CRITERIA] and scoring method. Open on one surprising but defensible placement, gameplay per item, close calls, summary. Not "objectively definitive".

list.name: Old vs New
list.prompt: Compare [OLD] vs [NEW] in [EXPERIENCE], versions confirmed, matched camera and conditions. A/B synced shots, measurable criteria, caveats, comparison table, capture checklist. No causation claims when variables differ.

list.name: Viewer Challenge
list.prompt: Turn [CHALLENGE TEXT] into a fair episode: validate safe, possible, compatible. Rules before recording, no private info. Challenge + stakes → rules → honest attempt → setbacks → result. Never invent a submission.

list.name: Speedrun / Route Test
list.prompt: Fastest or safest route for [OBJECTIVE] in [EXPERIENCE], [VERSION]. Define start/end, timing, shortcuts, resets; multiple attempts. Baseline → hypothesis → splits → comparison → best supported route. PB ≠ world record.

list.name: Randomizer / Wheel
list.prompt: Wheel [OPTIONS], objective [OBJECTIVE]. Document options and real result before the run. Rules → spin → adapt → escalation → result. No faked or secret rerolls; explain any reroll on screen.

list.name: Solo vs Co-op
list.prompt: Solo vs [TEAM SIZE] for [TASK] in [EXPERIENCE], matched settings; note what can't be matched. Setup + criteria → matched attempts → trade-offs → outcomes → fair conclusion labeled as observations.

list.name: No-HUD / Limited Tools
list.prompt: [OBJECTIVE] with [HUD ELEMENTS] off or [TOOLS] restricted; confirm support and exceptions first. Baseline → constraint → attempt → decision points → result. Keep failures and the restriction visible.

list.name: Can You Survive? Countdown
list.prompt: Timed survival in [EXPERIENCE]: timer, win/loss, resources, actions, verified from footage. Visible clock, real phase changes and obstacles, clear ending. If it ends early, keep that outcome.

list.name: Shorts: Mini Mystery
list.prompt: 9:16, [DURATION]s, one verified moment or question. First second shows it; no intro. Hook → minimum context → evidence → result or honest open question. Large captions, keep game audio, must stand alone.

list.name: Shorts: Best Moment
list.prompt: From [SOURCE VIDEO / TIMECODE], 15–35s vertical: setup → moment → payoff. No fabricated reactions or removed context. Point to the full episode only after it resolves.

list.name: What Happens If…?
list.prompt: Test [ACTION] in [EXPERIENCE]. State possibilities without asserting one; baseline, repeat, full outcome, confounders. Question → setup → test → replay → observed vs unknown.

list.name: Skin Showcase
list.prompt: Showcase [ITEM SET / THEME]. Verify real catalog items vs concept art; capture source and date for prices. Front/side/back, accessory close-ups, materials, movement, final reveal. Keep channel character unless it's a skin-ranking episode.

formats.handoffRule: If required facts or footage are missing, produce a research and capture plan first, not a fake finished script.
